init_distributed_model: wrap a PyTorch model with DistributedDataParallel for multi-GPU training with configurable bucket size
all_reduce_mean: compute the mean of a tensor across all processes in a distributed training job
gather_tensors_from_all: gather tensors from all ranks into a list using torch distributed all_gather
broadcast_object: broadcast a serializable Python object from a source rank to all workers in a distributed job
is_distributed_training_run: check if the current process is part of an active distributed training run with world size greater than one
